test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

My neighbours were serious injured in the car accident.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the first part of the given sentence, the incorrect form of the adjective 'serious' is used.
 
• The correct form should be **'seriously'** as it is modifying the verb 'injured'.
 
• **Adjectives modify nouns, while adverbs modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.**
 
• In this context, '**injured' is a verb, so it should be modified by an adverb.**

Hence, the correct sentence is **"*My neighbours were seriously injured__ in the car accident*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Adjectives describe or modify nouns and pronouns, whereas adverbs describe or modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
 
 
• **Example:** *She is a **quick** runner.* (Adjective modifying the noun 'runner')
 
• **Example:** *She runs **quickly**.* (Adverb modifying the verb 'runs')
 
 
 
• Adverbs often end in '-ly', but not always. Be careful to choose the correct form based on what you are modifying.
